svg.aria-label: One pmap step as a timeline. The host calls update_pmap once. On GPU0, which owns subdomains 1 to 37, and GPU1, which owns 38 to 75, the same program runs 10 outer scan blocks of 10 inner gradient accumulation steps, with one optax update at the end of each block, and every forward pass does a psum over NVLink between the two GPUs. A Python loop would have dispatched from the host 100 times.
svg.text: the host calls once, then waits
1 of 10 scan blocks, 10 inner steps, then one optax update
the same 100 steps as a Python loop
